title: NPPES New Brunswick individual practitioner sample
scope: First 200 NPI-1 city-search results only; not exhaustive and not hospital affiliation evidence.

rights.basis: CMS public NPI Registry factual records

limits: API sample capped at 200, not total population.
NPI registration is not verification of licensing, credentials, privileges, employment or availability.
Raw file is a documented projection: mailing/street addresses, telephone, fax, personal demographics, license numbers and alternate identifiers removed before persistence.
